entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello Alex. I'm calling about a VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought a little over a month ago. I need to see what my options are for a return. I think I might be just outside the return period.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it’s not a defect at all. The box is still sealed. Honestly, my life got a bit complicated right after it arrived. My father had a medical emergency and I was at the hospital constantly while he was having and recovering from surgery.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope he's recovering well.

He is, thank you. But right as that was settling down, my brother's military deployment got moved up unexpectedly, and I had to help his family get everything in order. The VeloBand just got put on a shelf and forgotten. I'm hoping we can work something out, maybe a partial credit?
That sounds like an incredibly stressful time for you and your family. Let me pull up your order and check the policy for you. One moment please.
Okay, I have your account here. I see the VeloBand was delivered about 40 days ago. It looks like you're actually well within the return window.
Really? I thought it was only a few weeks. That's a surprise.
Yes, our policy for the VeloBand GPS Tracker allows for returns up to 10 days after delivery. So, we can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you, no problem at all.
Wow. A full refund? That's fantastic. I was fully prepared to negotiate for a discount code or something. That's a relief.

Not necessary at all. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on your account right now. Just pack the device back in its shipping box, apply the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
I see the email. This was much easier than I expected. Thank you so much for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you quickly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things settle down for you and your family. Have a great day.
